sentences.text: The cited directions say a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on certain loans, but they do not state any monetary penalty amount for doing so.
The older foreclosure-charge circulars were withdrawn or superseded, so they do not provide the current penalty answer.

missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 and the withdrawn foreclosure-charge circulars for any RBI monetary penalty for levying prohibited foreclosure/pre-payment charges; no penalty amount was found in the cited materials.
